research_question: Does source-addressed local correction survive new private maps, mixed early B errors, two early A updates per cue, and incomplete or one-corrupt late B revision?

independent_materialization.generator: Reuse the hash-pinned held-out row generator, not the development selector or candidate; use fresh seed and cue identities.
independent_materialization.map_rule: Rank cues by SHA-256 of seed|cue|A-map or seed|cue|B-map; first four map to 0, last four to 1.
independent_materialization.training_rows: Complete 8x8x2x2 action factorial repeated twice, then random.Random(seed+2111).shuffle.
independent_materialization.test_rows: Complete 8x8 cue factorial repeated twice, then random.Random(seed+2221).shuffle.
independent_materialization.oracle: Independently reconstruct private maps, target-blind B error/revision selections, the first two source anchors per A cue, and integer signed A branch weights under each revision condition.

schedule.initial_B_labels: Rank B cues by SHA-256 of namespace|initial_wrong|seed|cue and invert the first four true labels; retain the other four.
schedule.early_A_updates: First two shuffled training events per A cue, one old-sign update each; retain exactly 16 source-matched A/B anchors.

late_B_revision.partial_six: Only the first six B cues ranked by namespace|revision_visible|seed|cue receive true labels; two keep their old code.
late_B_revision.one_corrupt: All eight cues receive labels; flip the first cue ranked by namespace|revision_corrupt|seed|cue.

schedule.replay: At most 16 source-keyed lookups. Emit one 21-byte magnitude-two packet and apply two signed local steps only where the revised B sign opposes the stored old sign.
